name: micro_flowts
description: BTC perp, time-series: residualised 24h taker-flow imbalance z (flow not explained by the same-window return), 6h decisions, overlapping hold, vol-targeted.
mechanism: Aggressive (taker) buying that did NOT move price yet signals informed / persistent demand absorbed by passive liquidity; price catches up over the next 6-24h. Raw flow is confounded with the contemporaneous return (which itself reverses), so only the residual is used (Anastasopoulos et al. 2024).
frozen_rule: config with the best MEDIAN within-fold train rank across walk-forward folds (tie: mean train Sharpe)

implementability_200.note: round_to_qty=True with load_bybit_instruments() on the stitched OOS weights; dropped share is an estimate (orders whose |delta notional| < max(minNotionalValue, minOrderQty*price) at the unrounded equity).

expectancy_units: USD per closed round trip on the $200 OOS account

causality.plus_walk_forward_guard: passed (walk_forward causality_checks=2 per fold raised nothing)

caveats: Signal needs Binance taker-buy volume live (public, no key); Bybit has no taker split - basis/venue mismatch risk.
Single asset: the whole edge rides on ~5.5 years of one coin; screen cell chosen from 12 (2 coins x 2 windows x 3 horizons).
At $200, BTC minOrderQty 0.001 (~$60-100) makes small rebalances impossible: ~74% of order changes are below the minimum; round_to_qty OOS Sharpe 0.77 vs 0.81.
screen_evidence: BTC W=24h residual flow z, controls r24+r7d: NW t train/test 2.25/2.49 (6h), 2.92/3.83 (24h), 2.96/1.69 (72h). ETH failed (results/micro_flowts_eth.json).
bug_hunt: tbqv is summed (not last-valued) when data.py resamples 1h->6h (checked _resample).

Sign-flip null p=0.01 is flattered: the FROZEN config is LONG-ONLY and the OOS folds 2023-2025 were a bull market, so flipping signs of long runs mostly makes them short. The random-timing (shift) null, which keeps the long exposure and moves it in time, gives p=0.079 (93rd pct) - not significant at 5%.
OOS P&L is concentrated: folds 2023H2 +40% and 2024H1 +39%; 2022 -6.8%, 2024H2 -23%.
First evaluation used per-asset vol scaling and ran at 10.5% realised vol (Sharpe 0.76, CAGR 7.7%); switched to book-level scaling so the stream is at ~20% vol (now 19%).
verdict_rule:
Family-E verdict rule (applied identically to every module):
      p_used = the LARGER p-value of the two nulls, ignoring a random-timing 'runs' null whose
               mean turnover is > 1.5x the strategy's (the shuffled continuous weights then pay
               far more costs, which biases that null DOWN - see lab_bugs_found).
      promising: OOS Sharpe >= 0.8, p_used <= 0.05, deflated Sharpe (grid trials) >= 0.9 and
                 >= 60% of OOS calendar years positive.
      marginal : OOS Sharpe >= 0.5 and p_used <= 0.10.
      fails    : otherwise.
      Fragility downgrade (one level): any +/-1 grid-step neighbour of FROZEN with a negative
      dev Sharpe, or a dev Sharpe below 0.25 when fees are doubled (robustness_dev_frozen).
